The moon now called Dormant is a desolate wasteland after having taken its part in the Grand War. While a majority has been fully destroyed, flukes in the heavy weaponry have spared this place from total destruction. A large amount of MK2 Core Heaters were used to wipe the moon off the maps. A similar, older model from those used to cause the Silent Flash. Due to the failure in technology, many of these bombs either detonated in orbit or lodged themselves firmly into the ground without detonating at all. Yet due to their unstable nature could not be retrieved. They now lie there, dormant.

> Moon Map

> Moon Info

POPULATION: Abandoned.

CONDITIONS: Warm, dry, toxic terrain, highly irradiated flora.

FAUNA: An irradiated, dying ecosystem.


Critical level explosive device detected.

> Environment

Dormant is an arid, dry, and rocky moon. While the trees and most other flora are dead, signs of life can still be found in small patches of greenery on more sandy areas. Ponds of green, toxic waste can also be found around the moon.

Its most prominent landmarker is the dormant, colossal explosive behind the ship lodged into the ground. Three concrete buildings and structures as well as metal fencing can be found around the moon as well. The larger building behind and west of the ship is the main entrance and the other two structures found northwest and east of the ship are both fire exits.

> Weather

Dormant supports Rainy, Stormy, Foggy, Eclipsed, Forsaken, and Hurricane weather by default.

> Moon Exclusive Content

The Bomb

Dormant naturally generates mines on its exterior, which can deal 30 damage to players or instantly kill nearby players and most entities depending on proximity to the blast. If any player causes a mine to detonate, it will destabilize the Unstable core-heater, i.e., the bomb. If five mines are detonated, the bomb will explode and instantly kill all players.

Interior Fire Exit

A lone fire exit can be found in the interior that leads to an area with dense foliage and many mines on the exterior. A Floppy disc machine can be found on the other side of this area. It is recommended to bring tools like a Jetpack or TZP-Inhalant to make crossing the area less risky. Players can not access this area from the exterior normally, as there is a damage trigger on the roof of the area that deals 999 damage to players that pass through it.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Crafting a Blank floppy disc on Galetry, inserting it into the Floppy disc machine found on the exterior of Selector, and logging the Dormant floppy disc.

Unlocks

Xenphir: Craft a Blank floppy disc on Galetry, insert it into the Floppy disc machine found through the lone interior fire exit, and log the Xenphir floppy disc.
